Package com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.model

package com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.model
Result value types for Peering Intelligence, all Lombok @Value (get-prefixed accessors) unless a hand-written accessor is documented.

The top-level PeeringIntelligenceResult aggregates the PresenceMatrix (ASN x metro grid of PresenceCells), per-network NetworkPresence, per-metro MetroPresenceReport, the optional ResiliencyAssessment (blast radius, correlated failures, ranked failover paths, diversity scores), UnifiedConnectivityViews, and PeeringOpportunity findings. EquinixIXMapping is the live-data bridge from PeeringDB IX/facility ids to Fabric MetroIds.
